name: Chair Dip
description: Strengthens the triceps: hands on the front edge of a chair seat behind you, bend your elbows to lower your hips, then press back up.

source.title: Chair Dips (Healthline)
source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Use a sturdy chair that can't slide, ideally with its back against a wall.
Sit on the front edge, hands beside your hips gripping the edge.
Walk your feet forward and slide your hips off the seat.
cues: Keep your hips close to the chair.
Lower until your elbows are bent to about 90°, or less if that's too much.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms.
Easier: keep your feet closer to the chair.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Arms straight
keyframes.cue: Hips just in front of the seat, arms straight.

keyframes.name: Lower
keyframes.cue: Bend your elbows and lower your hips.
